$comment: Every user-facing feature named in the panel registry or capability registry should have an explicit depth assessment. Keep this file honest: data-model-only is not rendered support.

features.label: Clone Source presets
features.evidence: Preset save uses document center instead of the captured sampling point; apply does not restore source coordinates.

features.label: Safe scripting DSL
features.evidence: Only a small command vocabulary is exposed and applyFilter bypasses worker, tiled, high-bit, progress and cancellation paths.

features.label: Local Libraries
features.evidence: IndexedDB image/color assets can be imported and placed; Adobe cloud sync is unsupported.

features.label: 3D UV/material rendering
features.evidence: UV paint data is sampled by the preview renderer; this remains a CPU painter preview, not a production 3D renderer.

features.label: Paths panel
features.evidence: Paths are derived from layer paths, vector masks and shape layers; there is no independent document-level named path store.

features.label: Animation panel
features.evidence: AnimationPanel is currently a direct alias of TimelinePanel and has no frame-animation-specific mode.

features.label: PSD color mode and bit depth
features.evidence: ag-psd writes RGB/8 bpc; non-RGB and high-bit intent is preserved as app metadata, not native pixels.

features.label: RAW/DNG
features.evidence: LibRaw/embedded preview path exists but coverage is reachability-only and camera/lens databases are approximated.

features.label: Generative Fill
features.evidence: Default local fallback is deterministic inpainting, not a generative model; model quality depends on a configured endpoint.

features.label: Creative Cloud Libraries
features.evidence: No Adobe account, licensing or cloud sync integration.
